mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.faction, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at, cl.id AS cl_id, cl.class_name, cl.level, cl.sort_order, cl.created_at AS cl_created_at FROM "character" c LEFT JOIN character_class_level cl ON cl.character_id = c.id ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, cl.sort_order ASC

SELECT c.id AS c_id, c.character_name, c.player_name, c.race, c.faction, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at, cl.id AS cl_id, cl.class_name, cl.level, cl.sort_order, cl.created_at AS cl_created_at FROM "character" c LEFT JOIN character_class_level cl ON cl.character_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{id}::uuid ORDER BY cl.sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "character" (id, character_name, player_name, race, faction, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{characterName}, #{playerName}, #{race}, #{faction}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE "character" SET character_name = #{characterName}, player_name = #{playerName}, race = #{race}, faction = #{faction}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO character_class_level (id, character_id, class_name, level, sort_order, created_at) VALUES ( #{id}::uuid, #{characterId}::uuid, #{className}, #{level}, #{sortOrder}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE character_class_level SET level = #{level} WHERE id = #{id}::uuid
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(level), 0) FROM character_class_level WHERE character_id = #{characterId}::uuid
